notes.title: Derpy Dino 2 is here!
notes.notes:
Get ready to experience your favorite game like never before!

[b]New Pixel Art Style:[/b] Immerse yourself in our vibrant, handcrafted pixel art world, where every detail has been lovingly reimagined to bring a new level of charm and character to the game.

[b]New Adventure Game Mode:[/b] Embark on a series of epic quests, each with its own unique challenges. Discover 5 new levels and 8 different enemy types in this exciting new game mode.

[b]Co-op Fun:[/b] Play with a Friend! Join forces with a friend and tackle the adventure or endless mode together!
